creatures.name: 대나무칼 사마귀
creatures.appearance: Tall compact jade-green mantis with straight split bamboo-blade forearms, narrow ivory face, dark yellow eyes and folded leaf-shaped wings. Two heavy hindlegs, sharp slim silhouette, no thorns and no handheld katana.
creatures.context: 좁은 골목을 빠르게 파고드는 개체. 기존 가시사마귀보다 날렵한 실루엣.

originalReview.note: 기획이 실제3 PNG를 직접 확인해 픽셀 질감·독립 실루엣 승인. 학과 사마귀 좌향, 적판다 허리띠·봉·꼬리 형태를 후속 모션에서 유지.

stand.label: 대기
stand.notes: 앞팔 칼날을 조금 굽히고 더듬이·들린 무릎이 움직이는 대기. 좁은 얼굴·잎날개·좌향 유지.

move.label: 이동

args.description: ONE entirely new miniboss monster sprite for an East Asian fantasy RPG. Tall compact jade-green mantis with straight split bamboo-blade forearms, narrow ivory face, dark yellow eyes and folded leaf-shaped wings. Two heavy hindlegs, sharp slim silhouette, no thorns and no handheld katana. Full body in a calm battle-ready stance looking LEFT, slightly elevated 3/4 camera. This is a native 96x96 PIXEL ART sprite: crisp one-pixel dark outline, coherent 2-5 pixel color clusters, only 3-4 HARD stepped shade planes with gentle volume, restrained palette. Draw a larger creature at the same pixel grain as existing native64 sprites. No tiny noise detailing, no antialiasing, soft gradient or smooth painting. Center within 6-8 pixel transparent margins so ALL feet, blades, wings, tail and cudgel are complete. Genuinely transparent RGBA, no ground, scenery, drop shadow, plinth, text, frame or external particles. Distinct anatomy and silhouette rather than enlarging or recoloring an ordinary enemy.

hit1.label: 피격
hit1.notes: 봉 한 개를 두 손으로 유지한 채 어깨·무릎이 조금 움츠러들고 눈을 감는 짧은 피격. 허리띠·줄무늬 꼬리·좌향 유지. 고정 입력 대기로 종료.

die1.label: KO
